scope: Actual owner voice tests; timing and source inspection, no retained speech in this evidence

first_start.cause: last_activity initialized during wakeword standby, not reset when active session starts
first_start.fix: Reset at active start and provider session.started; keep 120-second idle and 1800-second active caps

context_findings: First lookup selected country-level weather; authorized household context did not supply the home city to the selected query.
Follow-up correctly recognized the city, weather topic and next-day date; the actual external query contained the requested city.
Voice session had household audience, not verified private owner audience. Private Telegram/history must not be silently shared.
Home Assistant configuration has a generic home label, Dutch country, local timezone and configured coordinates; explicit city is not available in location_name.
Runtime reads durable recent messages but voice path selects voice.recent instead. Voice playback qualification must be preserved when combining authorized durable context.

followup_disconnect.observed: play task MediaStreamError; authority closed before final core reply
new_diagnostics: lifetime expiry category and idle duration
transport state at task failure and closure

latency_findings: Three serial model calls, all existing Sol contact route; no Astra work task in these two turns.
Public lookup writes a sourced answer, then contact model writes the final answer again.
Voice bridge ignores delta events and sends final Responses output only after complete authorized core reply.
No evidence that a shorter instruction, VAD change or switching networking libraries removes the measured core delay.

verification.initial_test_environment_failure: Endpoint test initially imported legacy /app/speaker module; rerun with actual /opt/eva entrypoint precedence passed.

proposal_in_order.change: Connect bounded shared household facts and authorized conversation continuity to existing context composition
proposal_in_order.purpose: Home location and prior topic available without per-question routing or private-person leakage
proposal_in_order.acceptance: Same authorized context through voice/text; follow-ups resolve antecedents; private histories remain private; playback is never assumed.

proposal_in_order.change: Compare compact evidence-only public lookup results with current full prose lookup; retain source validation and one final Eva wording step
proposal_in_order.purpose: Remove redundant answer writing using the existing generic public lookup, independent of topic
proposal_in_order.acceptance: Paired latency and factual/source checks across unrelated public questions; adopt only demonstrated improvement; no numerical speed promise.

proposal_in_order.change: Evaluate validated sentence delivery through existing core/voice bridge after eliminating unnecessary model work
proposal_in_order.purpose: Reduce time to useful speech while final answer is being completed
proposal_in_order.acceptance: No unvalidated tokens or stale unauthorized delivery; interruption and following turns remain correct.

proposal_in_order.change: Use installed terminal/ICE diagnostics to establish cause of any repeated track ending
proposal_in_order.purpose: Separate provider closure, ICE failure and local timeout; reconnect must not duplicate actions
proposal_in_order.acceptance: Repeated multi-turn sessions after long standby; no lost replies, no duplicated actions; measure end-of-speech to first useful audio plus full answer separately.
